pergunta: Quais 5 subcategorias mais cresceram percentualmente em faturamento de 2016 para 2017?
sql_referencia: WITH vendas_ano AS (  SELECT p.sub_category,     SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.order_date) = 2016 THEN f.sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2016,     SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.order_date) = 2017 THEN f.sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2017   FROM fato_vendas f   INNER JOIN dim_produtos p ON f.product_sk = p.product_sk   WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.order_date) IN (2016, 2017)   GROUP BY p.sub_category) SELECT sub_category,   ROUND(sales_2016, 2) AS sales_2016,   ROUND(sales_2017, 2) AS sales_2017,   ROUND(100.0 * (sales_2017 - sales_2016) / NULLIF(sales_2016, 0), 2) AS crescimento_pct FROM vendas_ano WHERE sales_2016 > 0 ORDER BY crescimento_pct DESC LIMIT 5
sql_gerado:
SELECT 
    p.sub_category,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.order_date) = 2016 THEN f.sales ELSE 0 END), 2) AS faturamento_2016,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.order_date) = 2017 THEN f.sales ELSE 0 END), 2) AS faturamento_2017,
    ROUND(100.0 * (
        SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.order_date) = 2017 THEN f.sales ELSE 0 END) - 
        SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.order_date) = 2016 THEN f.sales ELSE 0 END)
    ) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.order_date) = 2016 THEN f.sales ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS crescimento_percentual
FROM fato_vendas f
JOIN dim_produtos p ON f.product_sk = p.product_sk
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.order_date) IN (2016, 2017)
GROUP BY p.sub_category
ORDER BY crescimento_percentual DESC
LIMIT 5
resposta_agente: As 5 subcategorias que mais cresceram percentualmente em faturamento de 2016 para 2017 foram:  1. **Appliances**: cresceu **64,78%**, passando de US$ 26.050,32 em 2016 para US$ 42.926,93 em 2017. 2. **Art**: cresceu **48,69%**, passando de US$ 5.960,91 em 2016 para US$ 8.863,07 em 2017. 3. **Binders**: cresceu **46,50%**, passando de US$ 49.683,32 em 2016 para US$ 72.788,05 em 2017. 4. **Accessories**: cresceu **43,08%**, passando de US$ 41.895,85 em 2016 para US$ 59.946,23 em 2017. 5. **Labels**: cresceu **36,57%**, passando de US$ 2.827,24 em 2016 para US$ 3.861,22 em 2017.  *Ressalva: A análise restringe-se exclusivamente aos dados de faturamento dos anos de 2016 e 2017.*  Sugestão de próxima pergunta: "Quais foram as 5 subcategorias com maior queda percentual em faturamento de 2016 para 2017?"

pergunta: Quais 3 estados tiveram a maior queda percentual de lucro de 2016 para 2017, considerando apenas estados com lucro positivo em 2016?
sql_referencia: WITH lucro_estado AS (  SELECT l.state,     SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.order_date) = 2016 THEN f.profit ELSE 0 END) AS profit_2016,     SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.order_date) = 2017 THEN f.profit ELSE 0 END) AS profit_2017   FROM fato_vendas f   INNER JOIN dim_localizacao l ON f.location_sk = l.location_sk   WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.order_date) IN (2016, 2017)   GROUP BY l.state) SELECT state,   ROUND(profit_2016, 2) AS profit_2016,   ROUND(profit_2017, 2) AS profit_2017,   ROUND(100.0 * (profit_2017 - profit_2016) / NULLIF(profit_2016, 0), 2) AS variacao_pct FROM lucro_estado WHERE profit_2016 > 0 ORDER BY variacao_pct ASC LIMIT 3
sql_gerado:
WITH lucro_por_estado AS (
    SELECT 
        l.state,
        SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.order_date) = 2016 THEN f.profit ELSE 0 END) AS lucro_2016,
        SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.order_date) = 2017 THEN f.profit ELSE 0 END) AS lucro_2017
    FROM fato_vendas f
    JOIN dim_localizacao l ON f.location_sk = l.location_sk
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.order_date) IN (2016, 2017)
    GROUP BY l.state
)
SELECT 
    state,
    ROUND(lucro_2016, 2) AS lucro_2016,
    ROUND(lucro_2017, 2) AS lucro_2017,
    ROUND(100.0 * (lucro_2017 - lucro_2016) / NULLIF(lucro_2016, 0), 2) AS variacao_percentual
FROM lucro_por_estado
WHERE lucro_2016 > 0
ORDER BY variacao_percentual ASC
LIMIT 3

pergunta: Em 2017, quantos pedidos tiveram faturamento total acima da média de faturamento por pedido daquele mesmo ano?
sql_referencia: WITH pedidos_2017 AS (  SELECT order_id, SUM(sales) AS total_pedido   FROM fato_vendas   WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2017   GROUP BY order_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS qtd_pedidos_acima_media FROM pedidos_2017 WHERE total_pedido > (SELECT AVG(total_pedido) FROM pedidos_2017)
sql_gerado:
WITH pedido_vendas AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(sales) AS total_sales
    FROM fato_vendas
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2017
    GROUP BY order_id
),
media_pedidos AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_sales) AS media_vendas
    FROM pedido_vendas
)
SELECT COUNT(p.order_id) AS qtd_pedidos_acima_media
FROM pedido_vendas p
CROSS JOIN media_pedidos m
WHERE p.total_sales > m.media_vendas
LIMIT 100
